style: Bengali Aatchala (sloped eight-roofed vernacular temple style)
key_structures: Garbhagriha (sanctum with unique touchstone Kali idol)
special_features: Curved chala cornice reflecting thatched roof Bengali vernacular heritage
Iconic black touchstone image of Maa Kali with three golden eyes, protruding golden tongue, and four hands
Adjacent sacred Adi Ganga canal bank
materials: White lime plaster and stucco work
renovation_history: Original shrine dated to the Gupta era; current brick structure constructed under the patronage of the Sabarna Roy Choudhury family in 1809 CE.
